---
title: "Final Presentation"
subtitle: "Due Week 14 (Monday, November 30)"
---

- **Due**: Week 14 (Monday, November 30)
- **Points**: 5
- **Submit to**: Blackboard, and email to your UCA
- **Submission**: By Project

## Instructions

Submit your presentation by **Monday night** of Week 14, in two places:

- Upload it to Blackboard, **and**
- Email it to your UCA.

You must submit your presentation as a **PowerPoint attachment**. No PDFs, no
OneDrive links, no Canva links, no Google Slides.

Presentations are given **in class on the Tuesday after submission**.

The template below outlines the required slides in your presentation. You can
(and are encouraged to) use a different template.

::: {.callout-tip title="Presenting to your client"}
Some clients ask for a presentation of their own. This happens only if your
client requests it, and a client presentation may have different requirements
than the in-class presentation. Students who present to their client earn an
extra **professionalism point**.
:::

- [Presentation Template](files/presentation-template.pptx) (PowerPoint)
